item.text:
Yes. Vespa can expose querying and feeding through separate container clusters, so the endpoints—and therefore the hosts—can differ.

Configure one container with `<document-api />` for feeding and another with `<search />` for querying. The Vespa documentation explicitly notes that the endpoints are different in this setup. [Container endpoints](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/operations/self-managed/container.html#endpoints)

Use separate client endpoint configurations accordingly—for example, the feed client’s `endpoint` should point to the feed host, while query requests target the query host. [Vespa feed client](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/clients/vespa-feed-client.html)
